scope: Actual current weighted human/controller in a daylight metre fixture. Clothed-preview mode covers only four static portraits; full mode additionally observes real walk/run/jump and production swim/clothing transitions. Not OS input, a human scan, mocap, GTA asset, city navigation, performance or subjective comfort acceptance. Native pixels require separate visual review.
